detections.evidence_quote: Apheresis is a plasma exchange.
detections.summary: Physician guest explains therapeutic plasma exchange (apheresis): how the machine separates plasma, its uses, safety and replenishment, and the host describes feeling sharper after his own treatment.

detections.evidence_quote: So they're autoimmune diseases that build up immune complexes.
detections.summary: Plasma exchange was extended to autoimmune diseases that build up immune complexes in plasma.

detections.evidence_quote: People were coming even with like overdose of certain medications, and they would be in the plasma and they would die unless they got the apheresis done.
detections.summary: Guest recalls patients with medication overdoses who would die without apheresis.

detections.evidence_quote: like a digoxin toxicity, and so that would completely detoxify that.
detections.summary: Plasma exchange used in the emergency room to clear digoxin toxicity.

detections.evidence_quote: You're just removing the bad stuff that's circulating in your plasma.
detections.summary: Guest presents plasma exchange as removing toxic 'bad stuff' from the blood without adding any drug or chemical.

detections.evidence_quote: Immunoglobulins are, you know, the the infection fighting mechanism of a part of our immune system.
detections.summary: Immunoglobulins removed by plasma exchange regenerate more slowly, so at-risk patients get IVIG afterward.

detections.evidence_quote: I'm trying to fast on the airplane.
detections.summary: Host mentions fasting on his flight after the treatment.

detections.evidence_quote: So I had like the best airplane sleep I've ever had.
detections.summary: Host says he had the best airplane sleep of his life after plasma exchange.

detections.evidence_quote: it was like the light bulb went on, and I felt like I'd taken a limitless pill.
detections.summary: Host describes heightened mental clarity and alertness after plasma exchange, like a 'limitless pill'.

detections.evidence_quote: one of the key reasons that we age is immunosenescence and immune aging
detections.summary: Host and guest endorse an 'immunofatigue'/immunosenescence theory that cumulative overloading of the immune system is a key driver of ageing.

detections.evidence_quote: It's not like just glyphosate or just a vaccine or just horse leap.
detections.summary: Glyphosate and vaccines named among the cumulative burdens on the immune system.

detections.evidence_quote: 150,000 toxins in our environment that were never there just eight decades ago.
detections.summary: Guest says 150,000 new environmental toxins in food, air and water burden the immune system, raising how the body eliminates them.

detections.evidence_quote: The FDA lets them all go in our food supply.
detections.summary: Host says the FDA lets all these chemicals into the food supply.

detections.evidence_quote: anything that's living in your plasma that is toxic to your system can be removed with this machine
detections.summary: Plasma exchange framed as removing toxic material from the body.

detections.evidence_quote: We're not giving you a drug or a chemical.
detections.summary: Therapy praised because it adds no drug or chemical to the body.

detections.evidence_quote: longevity medicine and and anti aging bio optimization
detections.summary: Host frames the field as anti-ageing 'bio optimization'.

detections.evidence_quote: You know, there's 150,000 toxins in our environment
detections.summary: Modern environment framed as saturated with 150,000 toxins everywhere.

detections.evidence_quote: The FDA lets them all go
detections.summary: FDA portrayed as letting toxins into food.

detections.evidence_quote: And for years, I remember training as a resident.
detections.summary: Guest cites his residency experience with overdose patients saved by apheresis.

detections.evidence_quote: We would use this machine in the emergency room
detections.summary: Guest cites emergency-room use of the machine for digoxin toxicity.

detections.evidence_quote: That built up something toxic inside your plasma.
detections.summary: Mechanism offered: autoimmune disease builds up immune complexes in plasma that exchange removes.

detections.evidence_quote: I felt very zen, just kind of clean from the inside out.
detections.summary: Host's own post-treatment experience offered as testimony for plasma exchange.

detections.evidence_quote: Peter Diamandis and a lot of leading minds in in longevity medicine
detections.summary: Host invokes Dr. Peter Diamandis and leading longevity experts as backing for the immunofatigue theory.

detections.evidence_quote: the emerging thought process in longevity medicine right now
detections.summary: Guest appeals to the emerging view in longevity medicine.
